_about: Hand-curated segments shot COMPLETELY FROM THE SIDE -- the camera looks along the boxer's frontal plane, so what it sees is the sagittal plane and the opponent axis runs left-right across the frame, perpendicular to the camera. The sibling of ml/frontal_segments.json (camera standing in for the opponent), and the right sample for anything measured fore-aft: reach/extension along the punch line, hand return path, head travel off the vertical, weight transfer, chin over the lead knee. Selection is on CAMERA ANGLE, not on what the boxer does -- it is not a balanced sample of anything else.
_schema: stem -> [ {label, round, start_sec, end_sec} ]. Identical to ml/frontal_segments.json; ml/side_spans.py is the one reader and it reuses ml/frontal_spans.py's resolvers, whose docstring is THE spec for the span semantics (null starts/ends, the `round` binding, the _pts.npy indexing rule). Stems match ml/video_wh.json exactly (beware double spaces in titles).
_curated: 2026-08-08 batch 1 of an ongoing pass: 19 videos, covering the source list alphabetically as far as '4 EFFECTIVE BOXING COMBOS...'. Later batches append -- nothing downstream needs changing when they do.
_overlap_with_frontal: Two stems appear in BOTH sets, at disjoint times -- these videos change camera angle partway through, so a frontal span and a side span of the same video are different footage, not a contradiction. Never merge the two manifests on stem alone. See the _note on each entry.
